mapper.select: /* selectSellerMpCatalogRecharterHistoryPop */ SELECT A.RC_NO , A.RC_SEQ , A.REVISION , A.AGENT , A.BUYER ,(SELECT CMPY.COM_NAME_LOC FROM ICOMCMPY CMPY WHERE CMPY.COM_CODE = A.BUYER) AS BUYER_NM , A.BYIT_COMORG_CODE , A.BUYER_ITEM_NO , A.CONTRACT_NO , A.CONTRACT_SEQ , A.RC_TYPE , A.ATOB_DATE , A.ATOS_DATE , A.STOA_DATE , A.CLOSE_DATE , A.STOA_CLOSE_DATE , A.UNIT_PRICE , A.ATOB_UNIT_PRICE , A.LIST_PRICE , A.STOA_LIST_PRICE , A.A_NOTE , B.DESCRIPTION_LOC , B.SPECIFICATION , B.ORIGIN_CODE , (SELECT COD.TEXT2 FROM ICOMCOD1 COD WHERE COD.TYPE = 'M001' AND CODE = B.ORIGIN_CODE) AS ORIGIN_NM , C.MAKER_NAME , C.UNIT_MEASURE , C.MAKER_PART_NO , C.MIN_ORDER_QTY , TO_CHAR(A.ADD_DATE, 'YYYYMMDD') AS ADD_DATE , A.ADD_USER_ID , (SELECT USR.USER_NAME_LOC FROM ICOMLUSR USR WHERE USR.USER_ID = A.ADD_USER_ID) AS ADD_USER_NM , TO_CHAR(A.CHANGE_DATE, 'YYYYMMDD') AS CHANGE_DATE , A.CHANGE_USER_ID , (SELECT USR.USER_NAME_LOC FROM ICOMLUSR USR WHERE USR.USER_ID = A.CHANGE_USER_ID) AS CHANGE_USER_NM , A.S_NOTE FROM KEP_RCDT A, ICOMBYIT B, ICOMCQDT C WHERE A.BYIT_COMORG_CODE = B.BUYER AND A.BYIT_COMORG_CODE = C.BUYER AND B.BUYER = C.BUYER AND A.BUYER_ITEM_NO = B.BUYER_ITEM_NO AND A.BUYER_ITEM_NO = C.BUYER_ITEM_NO AND B.BUYER_ITEM_NO = C.BUYER_ITEM_NO AND A.CONTRACT_NO = C.CONTRACT_NO AND A.CONTRACT_SEQ = C.CONTRACT_SEQ AND A.RC_NO = #{st_rc_no} AND A.RC_SEQ = #{st_rc_seq} AND B.STATUS != 'D' AND C.STATUS != 'D' ORDER BY A.REVISION DESC
